$comment: Regression targets, checked by `pnpm perf:budget` after `pnpm build`. Each limit sits a little above what the site measured when it was set (2026-09-27, measured values in `measured`). Raising one is allowed; doing it silently is what this file exists to prevent. Time-based and data-dependent budgets (Core Web Vitals, database, images) are listed under `manual` and are checked against Lighthouse and the staging load test, not by the script.

fonts.measured: 194 KB: IBM Plex Sans Arabic, 4 weights x (arabic, latin). Every weight is used (font-medium 142x, font-semibold 114x, font-bold 72x). Lower this if a weight is ever dropped.

coreWebVitals.source: Lighthouse mobile (simulated slow 4G) on production pages; INP needs field data, TBT is the lab proxy

images.rule: No image in a list is served at more than twice its drawn size. Avatars are downscaled to 320 px before upload; logos go through next/image.

database.rule: Every query that returns user-scoped rows filters on the owner explicitly; row-level security decides what may be seen, the filter decides what to look at. No page reads an unbounded list.
database.source: staging load-test dataset: 10k agents, 12k jobs (3k live), 143k applications, 459k notifications

serverLatency.note: server-side render, function co-located with the database (bom1 <-> ap-south-1)
